title: Adjacency in the bipartite cover
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph. Two pairs $(x,c)$ and $(y,d)$, consisting of vertices and Boolean colors, are adjacent in its bipartite cover exactly when some neighbor index $i$ satisfies $G$'s neighbor at $x$ indexed by $i$ equals $y$, and $d$ is the opposite of $c$.
hypotheses_covered: A vertex type with decidable equality
A regular multigraph on the vertex type
